summary: Guía de eliminación y sincronización preparada en cinco idiomas; 20 pruebas documentales aprobadas y parche aplicado en copia limpia. Sin ejecutar el CLI, enviar cambios a Sotto ni firmar DCO. Kernel no ejecutado.
criteria: Document named removal and optional push/pull in the same staging environment, with login required for server synchronisation and no implied automatic sync.
Explain interactive picker, default-No confirmation, cancellation, --yes/-y limits and all terminal/CI gates; explain mandatory name and no confirmation in non-interactive use.
Explain tombstone visibility and retained history without promising secure erasure or provider revocation; do not duplicate the separate recovery walkthrough.

Keep all five READMEs structurally aligned with identical commands, pass the upstream README checker and its tests, cross-check claims against pinned Rust source, and provide an attributable portable patch with explicit execution and submission limits.
